title: I flagged two research papers for fake authors and both were accepted as orals
summary: A researcher conducted an experiment submitting papers with fake AI-generated author identities to academic conferences, and surprisingly both were accepted as oral presentations, revealing significant vulnerabilities in peer review processes for AI conferences.
problem_solved: Exposes how AI conference peer review systems can be gamed through fake author identities and lack of identity verification.
why_valuable: Highlights critical integrity issues in academic publishing that could undermine the credibility of AI research if left unaddressed.
